parsed.why: Decriminalised 2022, Pride/TDOR tolerated, pro-LGBT PM; but official hostility toward LGBT migration, employment law excludes gender identity, and a cleaver attack on a trans activist drew no jail time. No visitor-facing criminalisation or facility bans.

2024 package bans gender-marker change, pride and gender-diversity expression; interior ministry declared Pride 'impossible,' police arrested assaulted marchers, hate-crime law unenforced amid police homophobia, trans actress killed post-passage, NGOs crushed. State-tolerated targeting.

Decriminalisation and spouse-recognition rulings stand though poorly implemented; pride marches proceed without impediment, drop-in centre and health-professional non-discrimination apply. Residual risks are an unused sodomy law, immoral-practices PDA lever and administrative non-recognition — mostly resident-facing.

Never criminalised, but 45 anti-LGBTQ assaults in two months with influencer incitement, victim-blaming police, security-force raids targeting transvestis, conversion therapy, presidential anti-gay bill pledge, no protections; only a council statement mitigates.

No same-sex criminalisation since 1791, but no recognition, protections or working judiciary; 2017 advocacy-ban bills unresolved, 2018 official climate found hostility toward visible LGBTI people, advocate's 2019 death unexplained, camp harassment documented. Thin, dated, no recourse.
